title: wss: new @type messages conflict with RFC 8887 §4.3 MUST NOT
description: RFC 8887 §4.3 says 'Other message types MUST NOT be transmitted over this connection' and enumerates exactly three client-to-server and three server-to-client types. draft-atwood-jmap-chat-wss-00 introduces four new types (ChatStreamEnable, ChatStreamDisable, ChatTypingEvent, ChatPresenceEvent) over the same connection without addressing this MUST NOT. §4.3.1 also allows clients to close the connection on unknown messages; the WSS draft overrides this with MUST NOT close in §7, another tightening not flagged as intentional. Decision: explicitly supersede the RFC 8887 MUST NOT for implementations negotiating this capability, or require a distinct WebSocket subprotocol identifier.
close_reason: Added explicit paragraph to 'Relationship to RFC 8887' section stating that advertising the urn:ietf:params:jmap:chat:websocket Session capability is the negotiation event that permits the additional @type values, and that RFC 8887 §4.3's restriction applies only within the scope of the base protocol.
